semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in advanced packaging automation and overlay metrology systems for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Tokyo Aircraft Instrument Co., Ltd. is an advanced packaging automation partner that offers overlay metrology systems, specifically the MAC-R, designed for the production of power devices and legacy semiconductors. Their solutions enhance yield and reliability through automation and inspection of EUV masks and reticles.
capabilities: Overlay metrology systems for power devices and legacy semiconductors
EUV mask and reticle transfer systems
Flexible wafer handling for various sizes and materials
